name: koishi-plugin-chatluna-lyrics-mcp

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('test-build/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }))" && node --test test-build/tests/text.test.js test-build/tests/repository.test.js test-build/tests/mcp.test.js test-build/tests/performance.test.js
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
